_doc: Map positions for Sachkunde geo items (story 4.4): itemId -> targetId on data/maps-geo/germany.json (a state or city-state id, a river id, a sea id). The Erdkunde minigame derives the question kind from it: when the right answer is the target's name the player taps it on the map ('Wo liegt ...?'), when it is the target state's capital the state is highlighted for a Hauptstadt-Match. Items not listed here (and every karte item) are shown as plain choice questions. This file is not a topic file and is not listed in index.json.
